## Pricing snapshot (USD)
RU: https://aiskillab.work/pricing | EN: https://aiskillab.work/en/pricing
- Introductory call: free, 15 minutes
- Diagnostic: $120, 60 minutes, 14-day package credit
- Adults: Start $390, Personal $890, Intensive $1,290
- Kids 8-13: Mini $290, Creator $890, Studio $1,190
- Teens 14-18: Explorer $490, Portfolio $890, Builder $1,290
- Family Concierge: $1,490
- Workflow audit: $890
- Team training: from $390/session; 4-session minimum from $1,560; up to 5 people
- Implementation pilot: from $4,900; scope cap 35 hours
- Operating support: $490/month, 4 hours
- Operating partner: $890/month, 8 hours
- Office hours: $178/month, 2 sessions
- Pair: 1.6x the individual package; each participant 20% less
